svg.text: 6-Layer Progressive Deduplication · Reject Early · Verify Late
String equality check on raw fact text
If exact duplicate found → REJECT (O(1) hash lookup)
Lowercase · trim · collapse whitespace · Unicode NFC
New fact + existing fact are accumulative
If FTS5 similarity ≥ 0.75 → REJECT as near-duplicate
Pairwise embedding cosine similarity · O(n²) comparison
Exhaustive cross-check of candidates surviving earlier layers
If cosine_sim ≥ threshold → REJECT as semantic duplicate
Merge winners across candidates · highest-confidence fact survives
Fact with best source quality / recency score wins the slot
New fact stored · embeddings indexed · triples linked
